metadata.title: Senior Technology Leader, VP Workspace Virtualization Engineering

summary: Senior technology leader with extensive experience in Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI), Desktop in Data Center (DiDC), End User Computing (EUC), lifecycle management, performance engineering, and global escalation leadership across major financial institutions: Morgan Stanley, Bank of America, AIA, Edge Technology Group, and Merrill Lynch. Former VP & Asia Manager for Workspace Virtualization Engineering at Morgan Stanley, serving as the primary APAC escalation lead for VDI issues across APAC, EMEA, and NA. Hands-on innovator with proven ability to build AI-powered automation tools, dashboards, and agentic systems.
